Plover outperforms Avocet on both internal evals (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 82.7; Support Dialogue 83.9 vs 78.9), with the Support Dialogue gap being well outside run-to-run variance. Additionally, Avocet self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work, while Plover shows no significant preference against such tasks.

While Avocet's creative capability is solid, Plover's edge on generative tasks and slightly better Summarization and Support Dialogue scores (relevant for professional correspondence) make it the better fit for this straightforward business writing request.
